title: Section 2
author: 661c19cfd2e5746f7a928ac0
chapter_outcomes: Communicate clearly, accurately and effectively in writing
Use a wide range of vocabulary, and correct grammar, spelling and punctuation
Develop a personal style and an awareness of the audience being addressed
Read widely, both for their own enjoyment and to further their awareness of the ways in which the language can be used
Develop general analysis and communication skills such as synthesis, inference, and the ability to order facts and present opinions effectively
